title: Why neither MAGA nor Democrats are particularly bothered about Indian-Americans
summary_full: About 133 years ago, a man born Narendranath said he was from India and preached tolerance at the World’s Parliament of Religions in a speech that evokes awe even today. It’s sad that, so many years later, Americans of all stripes have become particularly intolerant towards his descendants.
